name: lightlysaltedhq-contracts

scripts.foundations: python3 foundations/scripts/audit_vectors.py && python3 foundations/scripts/check_derivation.py && python3 foundations/scripts/check_no_colours.py && python3 foundations/scripts/check_prose_lengths.py && python3 foundations/scripts/oklch.py && python3 foundations/scripts/contrast_rules.py && python3 foundations/scripts/selftest_emit.py && python3 foundations/scripts/check_scale_shape.py && python3 foundations/scripts/check_type_scale.py && python3 foundations/scripts/check_layout_roles.py
scripts.verify: npm run test:scripts && npm run verify:actions-pinned && npm run foundations && npm run verify:foundations-pack && npm run verify:type-tokens-bundle && npm run salt-contract && npm run salt-stylesheets && npm run salt-extensions && npm run salt-fixtures && npm run salt-conformance
